0.content:
# 🏁 Bindplane Lab Race — trainer view
Each participant is identified by their **`project`** value. A milestone counts the first time its **effect** reaches Dynatrace, not when it is configured. Collector-level milestones (pipeline live, cumulative to delta, signal to metric) are credited through the collector's `host.name`, mapped to the project it sends.

**Before the session:** set the timeframe to start at the session start (rehearsal data must not count), and pick trainers/colleagues in **Exclude**. Ranking = most milestones, then earliest time of the last milestone.

| # | Milestone | Counts when… |
|---|---|---|
| 01 | Pipeline live | First lab log (PAN-OS syslog or syslog/audit.log/fail2ban.log file) from your collector host |
| 02 | Cumulative to delta | Collector self-metrics reach Dynatrace (they are rejected until delta temporality) |
| 03 | Project tagged | First lab log carrying your project attribute |
| 04 | Parse CSV | PAN-OS records arrive with named pan.* fields |
| 05 | Delete body.message | Parsed PAN-OS records arrive without the raw CSV |
| 06 | Sampling | Allow share of parsed traffic drops below 80% (baseline ~93%) |
| 07 | Masking | BCH access key and secret arrive hashed (64+ hex chars), never raw |
| 08 | Parse regex | bch_access_key_id attribute extracted from the hashed value |
| 09 | Signal to metric | log.exposed_bch_credentials.count arrives with a hashed key dimension |
| 10 | OpenPipeline syslog | Host syslog records (file source) arrive with syslog.* fields from the OpenPipeline Syslog bundle |

2.title: Participants
2.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(host.name) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
| summarize first_ts = min(timestamp), by: { host.name }
| fields host.name, milestone = "01 Pipeline live", first_ts
| append [
  timeseries v = avg(otelcol_process_memory_rss), by: { host.name }, interval: 1m
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(isNotNull(v[]), iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields host.name, milestone = "02 Cumulative to delta", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
]
| append [
  timeseries v = sum(log.exposed_bch_credentials.count), by: { host.name, bch_access_key_id }, interval: 1m
  | filter isNotNull(bch_access_key_id) and not startsWith(bch_access_key_id, "BCHK")
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(v[] > 0, iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields host.name, milestone = "09 Signal to metric", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
]
| lookup [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and isNotNull(host.name) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
  | summarize n = count(), by: { host.name, project }
  | sort n desc
  | summarize project = takeFirst(project), by: { host.name }
], sourceField: host.name, lookupField: host.name, prefix: "m_"
| filter isNotNull(m_project)
| fields project = m_project, milestone, first_ts
| append [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
  | parse content, "LD 'BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=' NSPACE:bch_ak SPACE 'BCH_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' NSPACE:bch_sk"
  | fieldsAdd bch_sk = replaceString(bch_sk, "\"", "")
  | summarize {
      m03 = min(if(true, timestamp)),
      m04 = min(if(appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action), timestamp)),
      m05 = min(if(appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action) and (isNull(content) or content == ""), timestamp)),
      m07 = min(if(log.file.name == "audit.log" and isNotNull(bch_ak) and not startsWith(bch_ak, "BCHK") and stringLength(bch_ak) >= 64 and stringLength(bch_sk) >= 64, timestamp)),
      m08 = min(if(isNotNull(bch_access_key_id) and not startsWith(bch_access_key_id, "BCHK"), timestamp)),
      m10 = min(if(log.file.name == "syslog" and isNotNull(syslog.severity), timestamp))
    }, by: { project }
  | fieldsAdd ev = array(
      record(milestone = "03 Project tagged", first_ts = m03),
      record(milestone = "04 Parse CSV", first_ts = m04),
      record(milestone = "05 Delete body.message", first_ts = m05),
      record(milestone = "07 Masking", first_ts = m07),
      record(milestone = "08 Parse regex", first_ts = m08),
      record(milestone = "10 OpenPipeline syslog", first_ts = m10))
  | expand ev
  | fields project, milestone = ev[milestone], first_ts = ev[first_ts]
  | filter isNotNull(first_ts)
]
| append [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
  | makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), total = count() }, by: { project }, interval: 1m
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(total[] >= 30 and allow[] / total[] < 0.8, iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields project, milestone = "06 Sampling", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
]
| summarize first_ts = min(first_ts), by: { project, milestone }
| filter not in(project, array($Exclude))
| summarize {
    score = countDistinct(milestone),
    started = min(first_ts),
    last = max(first_ts),
    last_precise = max(if(in(milestone, array("01 Pipeline live", "03 Project tagged", "04 Parse CSV", "05 Delete body.message", "07 Masking", "08 Parse regex", "10 OpenPipeline syslog")), first_ts)),
    c01 = min(if(milestone == "01 Pipeline live", first_ts)),
    c02 = min(if(milestone == "02 Cumulative to delta", first_ts)),
    c03 = min(if(milestone == "03 Project tagged", first_ts)),
    c04 = min(if(milestone == "04 Parse CSV", first_ts)),
    c05 = min(if(milestone == "05 Delete body.message", first_ts)),
    c06 = min(if(milestone == "06 Sampling", first_ts)),
    c07 = min(if(milestone == "07 Masking", first_ts)),
    c08 = min(if(milestone == "08 Parse regex", first_ts)),
    c09 = min(if(milestone == "09 Signal to metric", first_ts)),
    c10 = min(if(milestone == "10 OpenPipeline syslog", first_ts))
  }, by: { project }
| summarize v = count()

  | makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), total = count() }, by: { project }, interval: 1m
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(total[] >= 30 and allow[] / total[] < 0.8, iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields project, milestone = "06 Sampling", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
]
| summarize first_ts = min(first_ts), by: { project, milestone }
| filter not in(project, array($Exclude))
| sort first_ts desc
| fields achieved_at = first_ts, participant = project, milestone

17.title: Stuck or slow — next milestone and idle time
17.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(host.name) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
| summarize first_ts = min(timestamp), by: { host.name }
| fields host.name, milestone = "01 Pipeline live", first_ts
| append [
  timeseries v = avg(otelcol_process_memory_rss), by: { host.name }, interval: 1m
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(isNotNull(v[]), iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields host.name, milestone = "02 Cumulative to delta", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
]
| append [
  timeseries v = sum(log.exposed_bch_credentials.count), by: { host.name, bch_access_key_id }, interval: 1m
  | filter isNotNull(bch_access_key_id) and not startsWith(bch_access_key_id, "BCHK")
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(v[] > 0, iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields host.name, milestone = "09 Signal to metric", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
]
| lookup [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and isNotNull(host.name) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
  | summarize n = count(), by: { host.name, project }
  | sort n desc
  | summarize project = takeFirst(project), by: { host.name }
], sourceField: host.name, lookupField: host.name, prefix: "m_"
| filter isNotNull(m_project)
| fields project = m_project, milestone, first_ts
| append [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
  | parse content, "LD 'BCH_ACCESS_KEY_ID=' NSPACE:bch_ak SPACE 'BCH_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=' NSPACE:bch_sk"
  | fieldsAdd bch_sk = replaceString(bch_sk, "\"", "")
  | summarize {
      m03 = min(if(true, timestamp)),
      m04 = min(if(appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action), timestamp)),
      m05 = min(if(appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action) and (isNull(content) or content == ""), timestamp)),
      m07 = min(if(log.file.name == "audit.log" and isNotNull(bch_ak) and not startsWith(bch_ak, "BCHK") and stringLength(bch_ak) >= 64 and stringLength(bch_sk) >= 64, timestamp)),
      m08 = min(if(isNotNull(bch_access_key_id) and not startsWith(bch_access_key_id, "BCHK"), timestamp)),
      m10 = min(if(log.file.name == "syslog" and isNotNull(syslog.severity), timestamp))
    }, by: { project }
  | fieldsAdd ev = array(
      record(milestone = "03 Project tagged", first_ts = m03),
      record(milestone = "04 Parse CSV", first_ts = m04),
      record(milestone = "05 Delete body.message", first_ts = m05),
      record(milestone = "07 Masking", first_ts = m07),
      record(milestone = "08 Parse regex", first_ts = m08),
      record(milestone = "10 OpenPipeline syslog", first_ts = m10))
  | expand ev
  | fields project, milestone = ev[milestone], first_ts = ev[first_ts]
  | filter isNotNull(first_ts)
]
| append [
  fetch logs
  | filter isNotNull(project) and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
  | makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), total = count() }, by: { project }, interval: 1m
  | fieldsAdd idx = arrayFirst(arrayRemoveNulls(iCollectArray(if(total[] >= 30 and allow[] / total[] < 0.8, iIndex()))))
  | filter isNotNull(idx)
  | fields project, milestone = "06 Sampling", first_ts = timeframe[start] + interval * (idx + 1)
]
| summarize first_ts = min(first_ts), by: { project, milestone }
| filter not in(project, array($Exclude))
| summarize {
    score = countDistinct(milestone),
    started = min(first_ts),
    last = max(first_ts),
    last_precise = max(if(in(milestone, array("01 Pipeline live", "03 Project tagged", "04 Parse CSV", "05 Delete body.message", "07 Masking", "08 Parse regex", "10 OpenPipeline syslog")), first_ts)),
    c01 = min(if(milestone == "01 Pipeline live", first_ts)),
    c02 = min(if(milestone == "02 Cumulative to delta", first_ts)),
    c03 = min(if(milestone == "03 Project tagged", first_ts)),
    c04 = min(if(milestone == "04 Parse CSV", first_ts)),
    c05 = min(if(milestone == "05 Delete body.message", first_ts)),
    c06 = min(if(milestone == "06 Sampling", first_ts)),
    c07 = min(if(milestone == "07 Masking", first_ts)),
    c08 = min(if(milestone == "08 Parse regex", first_ts)),
    c09 = min(if(milestone == "09 Signal to metric", first_ts)),
    c10 = min(if(milestone == "10 OpenPipeline syslog", first_ts))
  }, by: { project }
| filter score < 10
| fieldsAdd next_milestone = if(isNull(c01), "Pipeline live", else: if(isNull(c02), "Cumulative to delta", else: if(isNull(c03), "Project tagged", else: if(isNull(c04), "Parse CSV", else: if(isNull(c05), "Delete body.message", else: if(isNull(c06), "Sampling", else: if(isNull(c07), "Masking", else: if(isNull(c08), "Parse regex", else: if(isNull(c09), "Signal to metric", else: if(isNull(c10), "OpenPipeline syslog", else: "🎉 Finished"))))))))))
| fieldsAdd idle_min = round((now() - last) / 1m, decimals: 0)
| sort idle_min desc
| fields participant = project, score, next_milestone, last_milestone_at = last, idle_min

18.title: Collector identity — typos, duplicates, untagged
18.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(host.name) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
| summarize { projects = collectDistinct(project), last_seen = max(timestamp) }, by: { host.name }
| fieldsAdd n = arraySize(projects)
| fieldsAdd issue = if(n == 0, "❌ No project yet",
    else: if(n > 1, "⚠️ Host sent more than one project name", else: "✅ OK"))
| sort issue asc
| fields issue, host.name, projects, last_seen

19.title: Project names used by more than one host (duplicate names)
19.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(project) and isNotNull(host.name) and (appname == "PAN-OS" or in(log.file.name, array("syslog", "audit.log", "fail2ban.log")))
| summarize hosts = collectDistinct(host.name), by: { project }
| filter arraySize(hosts) > 1

20.title: Sampling check — allow share per participant (should drop to ~57%)
20.query:
fetch logs
| filter isNotNull(project) and not in(project, array($Exclude)) and appname == "PAN-OS" and isNotNull(pan.action)
| makeTimeseries { allow = countIf(pan.action == "allow"), total = count() }, by: { project }, interval: 1m
| fieldsAdd allow_share_pct = 100 * allow[] / total[]
| fields timeframe, interval, project, allow_share_pct

21.title: 💳 Payment challenge — OpenPipeline payment field extraction (separate from the race)
21.query:
fetch logs
| filter k8s.namespace.name == "astroshop" and matchesPhrase(content, "Transaction complete.")
| fieldsAdd participant = if(startsWith(k8s.cluster.name, "bindplane-logs-") and stringLength(k8s.cluster.name) > 24, substring(k8s.cluster.name, from: 15, to: stringLength(k8s.cluster.name) - 9), else: k8s.cluster.name)
| filter not in(participant, array($ExcludeCluster))
| summarize {
    payment_logs = count(),
    extracted = countIf(isNotNull(app.payment.transactionId)),
    first_seen = min(timestamp),
    first_extracted = min(if(isNotNull(app.payment.transactionId), timestamp)),
    clusters = collectDistinct(k8s.cluster.name)
  }, by: { participant }
| fieldsAdd pending = if(isNull(first_extracted), 1, else: 0)
| fieldsAdd status = if(pending == 0, "✅ extracting", else: "⬜ not yet")
| fieldsAdd coverage_pct = round(100.0 * extracted / payment_logs, decimals: 0)
| sort pending asc, first_extracted asc
| fields status, participant, first_extracted, payment_logs, extracted, coverage_pct, clusters
